title: KBC Table A — kbc_sample_inversion_burden
description: One row per (sample, inversion, POD segment). Per-sample, per-segment burden counts. Source: SPEC_KBC.md §3.A.

sample_id.description: Sample identifier from the project sample sheet.

inversion_id.description: Inversion identifier from the inversion atlas.

pod_segment.description: POD partition: L / M / R for double-crossover candidates; whole for single-crossover.

karyotype_class.description: PCAngsd K=3 + Hungarian-matched karyotype. NA = posterior below project cutoff.

n_damaging_variants.description: Damaging variants this sample carries inside the segment. Informational only — not used as the response variable; see §1.3.

het_masked_gene_count.description: Genes where one copy carries a damaging variant and the other is intact (no in-trans damaging variant at the same gene; no ROH overlap).

hom_exposed_gene_count.description: Genes where both copies are damaged (homozygous variant, or a single het inside an ROH-promoted region). This is the headline burden quantity.

compound_het_unknown_gene_count.description: Genes with two or more damaging hets where phase is not determinable from genotype alone. NOT counted as hom_exposed.

burden_score_sum.description: Sum of per-variant scores (from scoring_weights.tsv), restricted to damaging classes.

is_pruned_unrelated.description: True if sample is in the NAToRA-pruned 81-unrelated subset.

roh_overlap_frac.description: Fraction of this segment covered by ROH for this sample.
